title: Turnover Scenario-2 Alternate Qualification Threshold
verbatim_quote: Scenario-2 a) Turnover: Bidder must have achieved minimum annual financial turnover (at current price level) from contract receipt of works (in all classes of civil engineering construction works or O&M services only) of Rs. 10 Crores in any three financial years out of last Five (5) financial years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
importance: CRITICAL: Provides alternate qualification pathway if bidder lacks 1-year water O&M experience but has >= Rs. 10 Cr annual turnover.

title: Turnover Annual Price Escalation Weightage Formula
verbatim_quote: Turnover of previous year shall be given additional weightage of ten percent per year to bring them to current price level to account for price escalation as illustrated below: 2021-2022: 1.61 x F, 2022-2023: 1.46 x E, 2023-2024: 1.33 x D, 2024-2025: 1.21 x C, 2025-2026: 1.10 x B, Base Year 2026-2027: 1.00 x A.
importance: CRITICAL: Evaluator must multiply past years turnover by compounding escalation factors (up to 1.61x).

title: Bidder Legal Constitution Requirement
verbatim_quote: The bidder should be a company registered under Companies Registration act 1956/2013 or Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, or a Proprietorship registered in India as on bid submission date.
importance: MANDATORY: Restricts eligible entities to Indian Registered Company, LLP, or Proprietorship.

title: Comprehensive Blacklisting / Debarment Gate
verbatim_quote: Bidder should not be under the effect of blacklisting/debarment by any Ministry of Government of India or by any State Government of any other State in India or by Government of Gujarat or any of the Government PSUs at the time of bidding.
importance: CRITICAL: Broad government-wide debarment check required.

title: Electrical Contractor License Requirement
verbatim_quote: Electrical contractor’s license issued by Electric Licensing Board, Gandhinagar
importance: CRITICAL: Mandatory statutory license for electromechanical operations.

title: Absolute Subcontractor & Sublet Experience Disqualification
verbatim_quote: Experience as sub-contractor shall not be considered... The experience of sublet works shall not be considered.
importance: CRITICAL: Prime contractor experience only; subcontracted experience is completely rejected.

title: Minimum Experience Duration for Scenario-1
verbatim_quote: The bidder shall have successfully completed operation and maintenance for minimum 1 years for any water supply system or part of its civil or electromechanical components such as water supply network, WTP, pumping machineries, intake/ offtake structure, storage structures, municipal STP or municipal sewage network etc. in last Five (5) financial years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
importance: CRITICAL: Defines the minimum duration (1 year) and valid facility types for Scenario 1 experience.

title: Government / Board / Corporation Issuing Authority Requirement
verbatim_quote: The experience of O & M works executed in Government (State/Central), Board, Corporation, and Government Undertaking /Organisations of state & central government shall only be considered for evaluation... In case of Nagarpalika, the experience certificate of duly Sign by Chief officer shall only be considered.
importance: CRITICAL: Rejects private client experience; requires Govt/PSU/Nagarpalika client certificate.

title: Bid Validity and EMD Validity Periods
verbatim_quote: Bid Validity Period: 180 Days from the last date of submission of bid... EMD valid up to 28 days from the date of closure of the bid validity period of 180 days i.e. (Total of 180+28=208 days)
importance: PROCEDURAL: Bidder offer must remain valid for 180 days; BG must be for 208 days.

title: Physical Instrument Submission Deadline & 3-Year Banning Rule
verbatim_quote: bidder shall send the same in original through SPEED POST/HAND DELIVERY so as to reach to “Executive Engineer, Public Health Works Division- Radhanpur... of Seven days from the last date of bidding by 15:00. For not submitting DD/FDR/BG in original, bidder shall be banned to participate in any tender of the Board for period of 3 years as a penal action.
importance: CRITICAL GATE: Physical submission within 7 days is mandatory; failure invokes 3-year ban.

title: Non-Judicial Stamp Paper Form-H Declaration
verbatim_quote: TO BE EXECUTED ON NON-JUDICIAL E-STAMP PAPER OF Rs. 300/- AND SUBMITTED BY THE TENDERER ALONGWITH HIS TENDER IN A SEPARATE COVER
importance: PROCEDURAL: Form-H must be on Rs. 300 stamp paper and notarized.

title: Litigation History 10-Year Disclosure Requirement
verbatim_quote: Company’s history of litigation or arbitration / Debarment / Blacklisting from contract executed in the last ten years or currently under execution. Please indicate for each case the year, name of employer, cause, matter in dispute, disputed amount, and whether the award was for or against the company.
importance: EVALUATED: Full 10-year litigation and arbitration history must be provided in Form 6.

title: Prohibition of Multiple Bids by Same Bidder
verbatim_quote: Not more than one tender shall be submitted by a Bidder... A bidder who submits more than one bid in the particular work will be disqualified.
importance: DISQUALIFYING: Strict rule against multiple entity submissions.

title: Joint Venture / Consortium Omission (Inherent Single-Entity Rule)
verbatim_quote: To qualify, each bidder in the same name and style should have achieved the following performances... Bid is submitted as: a) An individual/ proprietary firm, b) A partnership firm, c) A limited Company or Corporation.
importance: ARCHITECTURAL: Zero JV clauses exist in this tender; bids must be submitted by a single entity in the same name and style.
